My question is whether I am doing analyses correctly. Specifically, 

1. Do my model defined in R correctly reflect my hypothesized causal relations shown above?
2. Did I correctly treat the binary response variable?
3. My path diagram produced is not pretty. Could you please provide me a better code to produce a better one?


The below is my R codes:


# Convert a binary response variable ("Presence") to ordered factor variable
dat[,"Presence"] <- ordered(dat[,1])

library(lavaan)

# Define my model
mod <- 'Moist ~ Ivy + Overstory            # soil moisture is affected by English ivy cover and the number of overstory trees
        Abundance ~ Moist + Ivy             # prey (salamander food) abundance is affected by soil moisture and ivy cover
        Overstory ~ Ivy                           # The number of overstory trees is affected by ivy 
        Presence ~ Moist + Abundance'  # The salamander occurrence is affected by the soil moisture and prey abundance

fit <- sem(mod, data=dat)
summary(fit)

# Create a path diagram
library(semPlot)
semPaths(fit, what = "std", layout = "tree", title = TRUE, style = "LISREL")


Thank you in advance for taking time to consider my questions.
